title: A plugin-data worker distill keeps the worktree's entry script but runs with the main checkout as its working directory
goal: With CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA set and CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT a worker's worktree, ql_base.launch_places returns the worktree's own querylog.py entry and the clone's main checkout as the working directory, so the session-end distill still reads the plugin data spool and bl_procs.classify does not call a waiting distill an orphan that makes land refuse the worktree
notes: Found by the SP-g2ssvhi2 review (S2): ST-oftholty's fix (88137f72a) returns (ENTRY, HOME) when plugin_data() is set, so ql_distill.detach (ql_distill.py:1152) starts the distill with cwd in the worker's worktree; bl_procs.hook_logs (bl_procs.py:169) matches only <checkout>/_cache/querylog/distill.log, so a plugin-data distill waiting on the lock classifies as orphan, not hook, and land refuses the worktree and selfcheck fails for up to USAGE_LOCK_WAIT_S. The landed test asserts (worker entry, worker) and bakes that in.
